meta_title: XShot — Let your screen do the talking.
meta_description: Native screenshots and product demos for your Mac. Capture, annotate, style and pin images, or record a workflow with automatic zoom. Open source. Local by design.
hero_description:
Native Mac screenshots, annotations
and product demos.
hero_aside:
Native screenshots, annotations
and product demos for your Mac.
local_processing: Made for your Mac. Kept on your Mac.
annotation_tools:
A little annotation.
A lot more clarity.
hero_image_alt: The real XShot editor, with annotation tools and the screenshot styling panel. Launchboard is demonstration content.
scene_description: A little padding, a softer shadow. Ready to share.
evidence_note: Real XShot interface. Launchboard is sample content. App UI currently in Chinese.
capture_intro: A bug to explain. An idea to share. A reference to keep close. The small things, taken care of.
capture_feature_title: Pick it. Mark it. Send it.
capture_feature_text: Click a window or drag an area. Add an arrow, a note or a mosaic. Press Enter to copy.
style_feature_text: Padding, corners, backgrounds and shadows. The same finish in your preview, clipboard and PNG.
pin_feature_text: Pin an image above your windows. Move it, resize it, or turn down its opacity while you work.
feature_image_alt: The actual XShot capture interface with window selection and a floating annotation toolbar.
demo_intro: Walk through a feature, hand over a workflow, or show someone exactly where to click.
studio_image_alt: The real XShot demo editor with video preview, automatic zoom segments and focus controls.
studio_caption: Record a display, window or area. Fine-tune the focus afterwards.
mp4_text: Clicks become smooth zooms. Adjust the focus, timing and retained range, then export an H.264 MP4.
html_text: Edit screenshots, notes and hotspots. Export one HTML file that plays offline, at your viewer’s own pace.
recording_limits: No audio. Source recordings up to 1920 px wide. HTML walkthroughs use screenshots and hotspots; they do not control the real product.
local_text: No account to create. No upload before you can begin. Capture and edit locally, then choose what to share.
folder_note: One local project. Keep the whole package when you move or back it up.
getting_started_text: Install XShot and allow screen access.
shortcuts_title: Keep your hands on the keys
shortcuts_text: The shortcuts for capture, annotations and recording.
troubleshooting_text: App launch, permissions and export troubleshooting.
proof_sequence_label: From a capture to a clear message
workflow_description: Choose the frame. Add your point. Send a clearer picture.
overview_capture_text: A window, an area, the point you need. Fast, precise, ready to mark.
overview_style_text: Backgrounds, space and soft shadows. Give your screenshot a little finish.
overview_demo_text: Record the flow. Bring each click into focus. Make the next step clear.
style_image_alt: The actual XShot screenshot styling panel with padding, corners and shadow controls.
paper_instructions: Drag the corner toward the top left to peel back the screenshot. Press Enter or Space to open or close it. Arrow keys adjust the curl. Escape closes it. Select a numbered layer to explore the other sheets.
walkthrough_frame_title: Release workflow — interactive HTML exported by XShot
walkthrough_caption: Real XShot export · Sample workspace · 5 steps. Click the blue hotspot to continue.
